binding_encoding.serialization: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted by Unicode code point; no insignificant whitespace; ensure_ascii=false; separators ',' and ':'; null/boolean/integer/string/array/object only
binding_encoding.reason: Binding objects must be reproducible without binary-floating formatting ambiguity. Exact numeric quantities remain strings/integers under the owning numeric contract.

semantic_guards: physical-validity authority is not candidate output
expected result authority is not candidate output
oracle is explicitly independent from candidate decisive implementation
generator is candidate-blind
accuracy_digest binds the exact declared accuracy vector
required stages are explicit rather than inferred from candidate success text
independent controls and historical imports do not have to impersonate an F01-F16 mandatory family
fixture.family_rule: MANDATORY_FAMILY requires F01..F16; controls/imports may use null or an explicit F01..F16 mapping without changing the mandatory family registry

semantic_guards: all seven material/topology/reconstruction/STEP A-D stage keys are always present
missing work is NOT_EXECUTED rather than omission
candidate source/configuration and programme checker identities are hashed
candidate self-verdict/final/gate/capability verdict fields are forbidden
timeout/resource refusal/error/crash are terminal observations, not success
research completion does not imply a capability gate
negative and blocked findings remain explicit
native_execution is recorded separately from static/model evidence
ACCEPTED requires at least one bound evidence reference
ACCEPTED authority is MC-1-programme rather than a candidate
OPEN/REFUTED/REVIEWED are not silently promoted by issue closure
programme verdict binds exact fixture and result digests
source/profile/accuracy/checker mismatches fail closed
required stages must pass and terminal_reason must be SUCCEEDED for PASS
candidate-provided SOLVED/PASS strings never constitute programme authority

scope_limit: This contract verifies schema/version/source/profile/stage/authority binding only. It does not establish geometric correctness, oracle correctness, certificate mathematics, engineering interoperability or any MC capability gate by itself.
